pages.text:
CiteWise Sample Document
CiteWise is a lightweight PDF ingestion system.
It extracts text, detects scanned pages, and uses OCR.
The pipeline preserves page numbers and document metadata.

Why Chunking Matters
Chunking splits long documents into smaller passages.
Each chunk retains its source page for future citations.
Overlap can preserve context between adjacent chunks.

Project Test Facts
Project: CiteWise
Stage: PDF ingestion
Text extraction: PyMuPDF
OCR engine: Tesseract
Default chunk size: 1000 characters
Default overlap: 150 characters
